source: Claessens et al. Br J Nutr 2007 doi 10.1017/S0007114507886314; thesis chapter 3 Figure 3.1A (soy) and 3.1B (whey), PDF page 45 (thesis p.44)
method: Vector digitization of filled bar rectangles from the PDF content stream (digitize.py); scale from printed ticks 0-2000 (step 200) and gridlines, least squares through bar baseline; SEM = upper whisker length.
units: As printed on axis: Total AUC for plasma insulin (mU*2h*mL-1); net area (above minus below baseline) 0-120 min; no conversion. Magnitude suggests a microunit/minute-type scale; label ambiguity flagged, ratios unaffected.
reading_half_width_basis: Declared before scoring: covers max gridline-fit residual (5.2) and fitted-vs-height difference (3.4).

significance_symbols.soy: * over SPI 0.3 and 0.4 and over SPH 0.3 and 0.4 (differ from 0.6); $ intact vs hydrolysate (independent of load)
significance_symbols.whey: * and # over WPI 0.3 (differs from 0.6 and from 0.4); no $
